About

Support that’s fast, clear and human

I’m an IT Support Specialist based in Bengaluru with experience across first- and second-line support: diagnosing hardware, software and network incidents and resolving them within agreed timelines.

My day-to-day covers Windows administration, Microsoft 365, TCP/IP troubleshooting, ticketing systems and asset management. I like documenting fixes so the next incident takes half the time.

I’m a Computer Science graduate with experience in customer service and internships, skilled in Java, Python and Cloud Computing, with strong communication, problem-solving and teamwork. I’m open to relocation and keen to join a team abroad where I can grow in infrastructure and cloud.
